lines.en: Jiwoo, how long have you lived in this town?
lines.sp: Jiwoo, how long've ya lived-in this town?
lines.ko: Jiwoo 씨는 이 동네에 얼마나 살았어요?

lines.en: For about ten years. And you?
lines.hk: 퍼 어바웃 텐 이어즈. 은 유?

lines.en: We moved here two years ago.
And you work at the library, right?
lines.hk: 은 유 워캣 더 라이브러리, 라잇?

lines.en: Yes, I've worked there since March. How long have you worked at your company?
lines.sp: Yeah, I've worked there since March. How long've ya worked-at yer company?
lines.hk: 예, 아이브 웍트 데어 씬스 마치. 하울롱브여 웍댓 여 컴퍼니?
lines.ko: 네, 3월부터 일했어요. Jiwoo 씨는 지금 회사에서 얼마나 일했어요?

lines.en: Wow. I've known my best friend for thirty years, and it feels like yesterday.
lines.sp: Wow. I've known my bes' friend fer thirdy years, 'n it feels like yesterday.
lines.hk: 와우. 아이브 노운 마이 베스 프렌드 퍼 써디 이어즈, 은 잇 필즈 라익 예스터데이.
lines.ko: 와. 저는 제일 친한 친구를 30년 동안 알았는데 어제 같아요.

lines.en: Thirty years? So how long have we been friends?
lines.sp: Thirdy years? So how long've we bin friends?
lines.hk: 써디 이어즈? 쏘 하울롱브위 빈 프렌즈?
lines.ko: 30년이요? 그럼 우리는 친구 된 지 얼마나 됐죠?

lines.en: Since the day I moved in! Two years.
lines.sp: Since the day I moved-in! Two years.
lines.hk: 씬스 더 데이 아이 무브딘! 투 이어즈.

drill.prompt: Yes, I've worked there since March. How long have you worked at ____ company?
Thirty years? So how long have we ____ friends?
